name: Labios Salvajes
source:
Labios Salvajes (Wild Lips) is a visual novel +18 set in the history of [url=https://www.wattpad.com/story/139873639-tigre-boxeador-gay-furry]Tigre Boxeador[/url] from Wattpad.

A tiger saves you from being killed by a dark and strange figure. You want to meet him, but all he's trying to do is push you away. During your adventure to meet your savior, you will meet several boys who will catch your eye and change your life.

Which path will you choose? And what does the future hold for you?

[From [url=https://pedrolibros.itch.io/labios-salvajes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Labios Salvajes》（Wild Lips）是一部18+视觉小说，故事设定在Wattpad作品[url=https://www.wattpad.com/story/139873639-tigre-boxeador-gay-furry]《Tigre Boxeador》[/url]的世界中。

一只老虎救了你，避免你被一个阴暗诡异的身影杀害。你想见到他，可他一直试图把你推开。在寻找救命恩人的旅途中，你会遇见几位让你心动的男孩，他们也将改变你的人生。

你会选择哪条路线？未来又会如何？

[来源：[url=https://pedrolibros.itch.io/labios-salvajes]Itch.io[/url]]
